slides.title: Your VA isn't forgetful. [[Your process lives in your head.]]
slides.body: From a discovery call with a cleaning business owner.

slides.quote: I've had previous VAs that, you know, [[they keep forgetting stuff.]]

slides.title: The work repeats every day. [[The list doesn't exist.]]
slides.body: So every day, someone has to remember it.

slides.title: A daily task list [[she ticks off.]]

items.title: Did they check in on the day

slides.title: Put the scripts [[next to the tasks.]]
slides.body: She had already written phone scripts and quote questions. They belong where the work happens.

slides.title: Daily list first. [[Ready in a day.]]
slides.body: The full system was planned over three days. The task list came first.

slides.title: Before you hire again, [[write the list.]]
slides.body: Who on your team is still running on memory?
